g.text: Galerina sp lubrica ID02 iNat310930323 Idaho
PP980481 Galerina nigripes isolate3927 iNat195401307 Idaho

tspan.tspan: The ITS tree resolves major relationships, though subgroup placement is approximate, and its purpose is to illustrate the current sequencing status of Intermountain Idaho Galerina, not to provide a formal taxonomy.
